architectures.name: Hybrid fan-out
architectures.summary: Fan out to followers on write for normal accounts and merge celebrity posts at read time.

architectures.name: Pull-based feed with caching
architectures.summary: Fetch recent posts from followees at read time and cache the result.
architectures.bestWhen: Users follow few accounts and writes dominate.
drawbacks: Slow for users following many accounts.
Heavy fan-in load on post store.
